title: 凯尔特宗教与民俗祈福（Celtic religion）
rituals: 圣林（Nemeton）与自然圣地崇拜（概念层）
岁时四节点：Imbolc／Beltane／Lughnasadh／Samhain（概念层）
水边还愿、clootie wells 与护身象征（概念层）
issues: Missing explicit Nemeton / clootie wells / St Brigid’s Cross naming; seasonal cycle needed full Imbolc–Beltane–Lughnasadh–Samhain naming; risk of neo-pagan how-to being read as authentic ancient rite.
actions: Added Nemeton, clootie wells, St Brigid’s Cross; expanded Imbolc/Beltane/Lughnasadh/Samhain naming.
Kept concept-only educational tone; explicitly separated modern neo-pagan practice from ancient rite.

actions: Added Masale, Kyungu/Kifunyi, Mitambiko as concept-only naming; Christian overlay retained as public layer.
